items.body:
Hello friends, I quantized a Diffusion model to fp8. However I am seeing slowness (~%30) compared to half precision. Confirmed fp8 kernels are generated. What might be steps that I need to solve/Diagnose this problem? I was using vanilla TensorRT and that one was effectively generating execution paths. Both of them quantized with `modelopt`. I understand TensorRT-LLM has parallel functions underlying such as `multiply_and_collect` additional to vanilla TRT. but I can't identify the bottleneck.

Here is my QuantConfig

```
    "quant_cfg": {
        "*weight_quantizer": {"num_bits": (4, 3), "axis": None, "trt_high_precision_dtype": "BFloat16"},
        "*input_quantizer": {"num_bits": (4, 3), "axis": None, "trt_high_precision_dtype": "BFloat16"},
        "*output_quantizer": {"enable": False},
        "*q_bmm_quantizer": {"num_bits": (4, 3), "axis": None, "trt_high_precision_dtype": "BFloat16"},
        "*k_bmm_quantizer": {"num_bits": (4, 3), "axis": None, "trt_high_precision_dtype": "BFloat16"},
        "*v_bmm_quantizer": {"num_bits": (4, 3), "axis": None, "trt_high_precision_dtype": "BFloat16"},
        "*softmax_quantizer": {
            "num_bits": (4, 3),
            "axis": None,

        },
        "transformer_blocks*bmm2_output_quantizer": {
            "num_bits": (4, 3),
```
